summary: Quality lens over the full branch. The mechanism is one coherent chain: the fail-open PostToolUse hook records plan-mode markers (plan_body_digest, raw sha kept for forensics) and AskUserQuestion rounds; require_plan_mode_marker and the grill recorder consume exactly those records through evidence_path story-then-root; GATE_ROUND_FLOORS is a single named constant; the frontier and forge next state the enforced order; docs and decision 0048 say what the code does, pinned by a doc-consistency test. Fixtures mint provenance only through the real hook — no bypass path exists in tests or code. Live-proven on the story itself: the gates refused the story's own plan (restamp), grill (paraphrased chosen) and task order until corrected.
